blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)模型的大部分参数都属于其专家,标准训练将GPU内存中的每个专家梯度保留到最优化步骤. 这种记忆随着专家的数量和大小而增长,因此随着MOE模型的尺度而上升. 我们介绍Sonar-MoE,它更新了每个专家在后行时的呼声,并立即释放出它的梯度. 它带来了从密集模型到分批的MOE专家收分机的优化后置,因此GPU从未持有多层专家梯度. 在bf16中微调OLMoE-1B-7B和Granite-3.1-3B-A800M后置两个专家内核后端时,声纳-MoE将峰值内存降低19%至22%. 其更新与标准培训不采用专家梯度剪接法的比特式相同,被搁置的损失不超过所有基线的0.003。 每一步都要花17%至23%的时间进行全球规范剪接的标准培训。 更新整批分解的分解计数器,而不是单个专家,使得声纳-MOE的速度保持了快,因为它避免了20%到72%的减速,同时使用了相同的内存. 声纳-MoE与内存和速度方面所有参数的后向优化器相匹配,同时仍会剪接密度参数.

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale their parameter count without a matching increase in per-token compute, since each token is routed to only a few of many experts Shazeer et al. (2017) ; Lepikhin et al. (2021) ; Fedus et al. (2022) ; Jiang et al. (2024a) ; DeepSeek-AI (2024) . The cost is paid in memory. A model that activates one billion parameters per token still has to keep the weights, gradients and optimizer state of every parameter during training. In OLMoE-1B-7B ( Muennighoff et al., 2024 ) , for example, the experts hold 6.44B of the 6.92B parameters, and their bf16 gradients alone take 12.9 GB. On a single GPU, this gradient memory alone can decide whether fine-tuning fits at all.
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 模型在不匹配每托肯计算增加的情况下缩放其参数数,因为每个令牌都会被路由给许多专家中的少数专家 Shazeer等 (2017年); Lepikhin等 (2021年); Fedus等 (2022年); Jiang等 (2024a); Depseek-AI (2024年). 费用是在记忆中支付的。 一个每令牌激活10亿个参数的模型在训练期间仍需要保持每个参数的权重,梯度和优化状态. 例如,在OLMOE-1B-7B(Muennighoff等,2024年)中,专家持有6.92B参数中的6.44B,仅他们的bf16梯度取取12.9GB. 在单一的GPU上,这个梯度内存单能决定微调是否完全适合.

blocks.en: Much of this gradient memory is held for no reason. A standard training step runs the whole backward pass and only then calls the optimizer, so the gradient of the last MoE layer waits in memory until the backward pass has reached the first layer. An element-wise optimizer such as AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) does not need this wait, since the update of a tensor depends only on that tensor’s gradient and optimizer state. Prior work on dense models fuses the update into the backward pass ( Lv et al., 2024b ; Lv et al., 2024a ; Lewandowski and Kosson, 2023 ) , and PyTorch provides a hook that fires as soon as a parameter’s gradient is ready ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) . Updating every parameter this way frees all gradient memory, but it gives up global-norm clipping, because no gradient survives to the end of the step. In an MoE the experts hold almost all of the gradient memory, so it is enough to update only the experts early.
blocks.zh: 这种梯度记忆中的大部分都是毫无理由地被持有. 一个标准训练步骤运行整个后传,然后才叫优化者,所以最后的MOE层的梯度在记忆中等待到后传到第一层. AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019)等元素优化器不需要这种等待,因为更新收分数只取决于收分数的梯度和收分数。 此前在密集模型上的工作将更新内容导入后传(Lv等,2024b;Lv等,2024a;Lewandowski和Kosson,2023),而PyTorch则提供一等参数梯度准备好即起火的钩子(Paszke等,2019年). 以这种方式更新每个参数可以释放出所有的梯度内存,但是它放弃了全局规范剪接,因为没有梯度能活到该步骤的末端. 在教育部中,专家掌握着几乎所有的梯度记忆,因此仅提前更新专家就足够了。

blocks.en: We introduce Sonar-MoE , which updates the experts inside the backward pass. It attaches a hook to each batched expert tensor of every MoE layer, and when the tensor’s gradient is ready, the hook applies a fused AdamW update and frees the gradient, so the GPU holds at most one layer of expert gradients at any time (Figure 2 ). All other parameters keep the standard path with global-norm clipping. The placement of the hooks also matters. Expert weights can be stored per expert or as batched tensors ( Gale et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , and Sonar-MoE hooks the batched tensors. With E E experts per layer and L L MoE layers, per-expert hooks fire 2 ​ E ​ L 2EL times per step, while one hook per batched weight tensor fires only 2 ​ L 2L times. On OLMoE ( E = 64 E{=}64 , L = 16 L{=}16 ) this is 32 hook calls per step instead of 2,048, for the same update and the same memory.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Sonar-MoE, 它更新了专家 在落后的通行证。 它在每个 MoE 层的每个分批的专家分数上加一个钩子,当分数的分数梯度准备就绪后,取出一个被熔接了的 AdamW 更新并释放了分数,因此GPU在任何时间最多都持有一分的专家分数(图2). 所有其他参数都使用全局规范剪接来保留标准路径. 所放钩也. 专家权重可被每位专家所储存,也可被作为分批的活塞(Gale等,2023;Tan等,2024;Guo等,2025;Sonar-MoE钩入分批活塞). 每层有E E 专家,每层有L L ME 专家,每个专家会起火 每步2 EL 2EL倍,而每批重量拉伸器一个钩子只放出2 L 2L倍. 在OLMOE上(E=64 E{=}64,L=16 L{=}16),这是每步32个钩口呼叫,而不是2,048个,用于相同的更新和相同的内存.

blocks.en: In bf16 fine-tuning, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory from 55.6 to 43.6 GB on OLMoE and by 21.4% on Granite-3.1-3B-A800M (Figure 1 ). Its updates are bitwise identical to those of standard training without expert-gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of every baseline. Each step is also 19–23% shorter than in standard training with global-norm clipping (Table 1 ). Two effects shorten the step. The expert gradients skip the global-norm clipping kernels, which gives most of the saving, and on Granite the in-backward updates fill GPU time that would otherwise sit idle, which cuts a further 11.6% at the same update rule. Applying optimizer-in-backward to all parameters reaches the same memory and speed but cannot clip any gradient. Sonar-MoE matches it on both while keeping global-norm clipping for the dense parameters. Our contributions are: • Sonar-MoE , which updates each batched expert tensor inside the backward pass and frees its gradient at once. Retained expert-gradient memory is bounded by one layer, peak memory falls by 21.6% (OLMoE) and 21.4% (Granite), and the updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert-gradient clipping (§ 4 , § 5.2 ). • A speedup over standard training, with steps 19–23% shorter than under global-norm clipping, and a kernel-level profile that explains it. The expert gradients skip the clipping kernels, and on Granite the AdamW kernels run in otherwise idle GPU time (§ 5.3 ). Hooking batched tensors rather than single experts keeps this speed, since per-expert hooks make steps 20–72% slower (§ 4.3 ). • A direct comparison with all-parameter optimizer-in-backward, which Sonar-MoE matches in memory and speed while keeping global-norm clipping, and a measured operating range across batch sizes, gradient checkpointing, 8-bit AdamW and gradient accumulation (§ 5.5 , § 5.6 ).
blocks.zh: 在bf16微调中,声纳-MOE在OLMOE上将峰值内存从55.6降至43.6GB,在Granite-3.1-3B-A800M上则降低21.4%. (图1). 它的更新与没有专家分级剪接标准培训的更新相同,被搁置的损失保持在每一基线的0.003以内。 每一步都比采用全球规范剪接的标准培训短19-23%(表1)。 两次效果缩短了台阶. 专家梯度跳过Global-Norm剪接内核,这给了大部分节省,在Granite上,后退更新填补了GPU时间,否则闲置,在同一更新规则下再削减了11.6%. 在所有参数上应用最优化的后置程序达到相同的内存和速度,但不能剪接任何梯度. 声纳-MOE在同时保持对密集参数的全局规范剪接功能的同时,同时进行匹配. 我们的贡献是: 声纳-MOE,它更新了后行道内每批专家的呼号,并立即解开梯度. 保留的专家级内存以一层为界,峰值内存下降21.6%(OLMOE)和21.4%(Granite),更新时的位码与标准培训完全相同,没有专家级剪接(§4,§ 5.2). ^ 在标准训练上加快速度,步骤比全球标准剪接时短19-23%,以及内核水平的剖面说明。 专家梯度跳过剪接内核,在Granite上,亚当W内核运行在否则闲置的GPU时间(§ 5.3). 钩子的分批分解比专家要慢20-72%(第4.3节)。 直接比较Sonar-MoE在保持全局规范剪接的同时与内存和速度相匹配的全参数优化回转器,以及分批大小、梯度检查、8位亚当W和梯度累积的测量操作范围(§ 5.5,§ 5.6)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Systems work on MoE training has made the expert computation faster through better kernels ( Gale et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , better parallelism and communication across devices ( Rajbhandari et al., 2022 ; Hwang et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024b ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and a cheaper expert backward pass ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Data-parallel training overlaps the gradient all-reduce with the backward pass ( Li et al., 2020 ) . None of this changes when gradients are released.
blocks.zh: 通过更好的内核(Gale等人,2023年;Tan等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年),关于MOE培训的系统工作使专家的计算速度加快,并改进了各种设备之间的平行和交流(Rajbhandari等人,2022年;Hwang等人,2023年;He等人,2022年;Jiang等人,2024年b;Zhang等人,2025年b;Zhang等人,2025年),以及更廉价的专家落后通行证(Liu等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2026年)。 数据平行训练将梯度全降与后行通(李等,2020. 当梯度被释放时,这些都没有任何变化 。

blocks.en: ZeRO partitions optimizer state, gradients and parameters across ranks ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) , and ZeRO-Offload moves them to CPU memory ( Ren et al., 2021 ) . Activation checkpointing and reversible blocks reduce activation memory ( Chen et al., 2016 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , 8-bit optimizers shrink optimizer state ( Dettmers et al., 2022 ) , and Collage trains fully in bf16 without fp32 master weights ( Yu et al., 2024 ) . Other methods train fewer parameters or a smaller subspace: LoRA and QLoRA train low-rank adapters ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Dettmers et al., 2023 ) , ESFT fine-tunes only the experts most relevant to a task ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , GaLore projects gradients to a low-rank subspace ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , and BAdam updates one block at a time ( Luo et al., 2024 ) . Sonar-MoE updates every expert in full and changes only when its gradient is freed, so these savings add to ours (§ 5.5 ).
blocks.zh: ZeRO分区优化了分级状态,梯度和参数(Rajbhandari等,2020年),ZeRO-Offload将其移动到CPU内存(Ren等,2021年). 激活检出和可逆区块会减少激活内存(Chen等,2016;Liu等,2025),8位优化器收缩优化器状态(Dettmers等,2022),Collage列车在bf16中完全没有fp32主重(Yu等,2024). 其他方法训练参数较少或子空间较小:LORA和QLORA列车低等适配器(Hu等,2021;Dettmers等,2023),ESFT只微调与某项任务最相关的专家(Wang等,2024),GaLore预测梯度为低等子空间(Zhao等,2024),BAdam一次更新一个区块(Luo等,2024). 声纳-MOE只在其梯度解开后对每个专家进行全面更新并改变,所以这些节省增加了我们的(§ 5.5).

blocks.en: The closest work fuses the optimizer update into the backward pass of dense models. LOMO does this with SGD ( Lv et al., 2024b ) , AdaLomo adds adaptive learning rates ( Lv et al., 2024a ) , Lewandowski and Kosson (2023) run the optimizer step during back-propagation, and GaLore uses per-layer updates to avoid storing weight gradients ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . FORGE fuses gradient computation with optimizer updates in registers ( Kukreja et al., 2026 ) , whereas Sonar-MoE uses hooks to update and free materialized gradients of batched expert tensors. PyTorch’s post-accumulate hooks make this available for every parameter ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) , which we call all-parameter optimizer-in-backward. We do not claim the in-backward update itself, only the choice of where to apply it. Hooking every parameter frees all gradient memory but rules out global-norm clipping ( Pascanu et al., 2013 ) , while hooking only the batched expert tensors frees almost as much and keeps clipping for the rest of the model.
blocks.zh: 最接近的工作将优化器的更新导入密集型号的后传. LOMO这样做与SGD(Lv等,2024b.),AdaLomo增加适应性学习率(Lv等,2024a.),Lewandowski和Kosson(2023.)在后向传播过程中运行了最优化步骤,而GaLore使用每层更新来避免存储重量梯度(Zhao等,2024.). FORGE用登记册中最优化的更新计算出梯度(Kukreja等,2026年),而Sonar-MoE则使用钩子来更新和自由实现分批专家的梯度。 PyTorch的积分后钩使每个参数(Paszke等,2019年)都可以使用这个参数,我们称之为全参数优化后向. 我们并不声称自己是背向更新的,而是选择在何处适用。 钩入每个参数可以释放出所有梯度内存,但排除了全局规范剪接(Pascanu等,2013年),而钩入只有批量的专家收录器可以几乎同样地释放出并不断为其余模型进行剪接.

blocks.en: A training step keeps four kinds of data on the GPU. Parameters and optimizer state stay resident across steps. Activations are freed during backward as soon as they have been used. Gradients stay in memory until the optimizer step, so by the end of backward every gradient of the model is held at once. In our setting, weights, gradients and AdamW states are all kept in bf16, so the gradients take as much memory as the weights. This gradient memory is what Sonar-MoE releases early.
blocks.zh: 一个训练步骤保存了GPU的四种数据. 参数和最优化状态在跨台阶中停留。 活动一旦被使用,则在后向状态下释放。 渐变在内存中一直停留到最优化步骤,因此到后向末期,模型的每一个渐变都同时被保持. 在我们的设定中,权重,梯度和亚当W状态都保存在bf16中,因此梯度和权重一样需要记忆. 这个梯度内存是声纳-MOE提前发布的内容.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: We pick two public MoE models of different sizes and expert counts that both run on batched expert kernels. We fine-tune allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0924 ( Muennighoff et al., 2024 ) (16 MoE layers, 64 experts, top-8) and ibm-granite/granite-3.1-3b-a800m-base ( IBM Granite Team, 2024 ) (32 MoE layers, 40 experts) on 8,000 Alpaca examples ( Taori et al., 2023 ) for 2,000 steps. A held-out set of 500 further examples (indices 8000–8499 of the same seed-42 shuffle) is disjoint from training. We use a batch size of 2, sequences of at most 256 tokens and no gradient accumulation. The learning rate peaks at 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} after 100 warm-up steps and decays with a cosine schedule toward 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} . AdamW uses β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta{=}(0.9,0.95) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon{=}10^{-8} and no weight decay. Training is in bf16, with weights, gradients and AdamW states all kept in bf16 and no fp32 master weights. All arms use seed 42 and the same data order, which we check by hashing the first batches.

blocks.en: Standard training with global clipping runs the backward pass, clips the global gradient norm of all parameters to 1.0 and takes one fused AdamW step. This is the usual default. Standard training without expert-gradient clipping is the same but clips only the non-expert parameters. It performs exactly the Sonar-MoE update, so any speed difference between the two comes from when the update happens rather than from the update itself. All-parameter optimizer-in-backward updates every parameter in its own backward hook, so no clipping is possible. We also run Sonar-MoE with per-expert hooks , one optimizer per expert slice, as an ablation.
blocks.zh: 用全局剪接进行的标准训练会跑出后行道,将所有参数的全球梯度规范剪接到1.0并取出一个被熔接的AdamW步骤. 这是通常的默认。 没有专家分级剪接的标准培训是一样的,但剪接只是非专家参数。 它完全执行Sonar-MoE更新,所以两者的任何速度差异都来自更新发生时,而不是更新本身. 全参数优化后置更新了自身后置钩上每个参数,因此不可能进行剪接. 我们还用每个专家的钩子管理声纳 -MOE, 每个专家的切片一个优化器, 做成一个活塞。

blocks.en: We run every method with two expert-kernel libraries that store experts in batched tensors, SonicMoE ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and ScatterMoE ( Tan et al., 2024 ) . Table 1 reports both; the other experiments use SonicMoE.

blocks.en: Sonar-MoE saves the memory that the mechanism predicts (Table 1 ). With SonicMoE, peak memory falls by 12.0 GB on OLMoE and 5.8 GB on Granite, which is the expert-gradient buffer of 12.9 and 6.0 GB minus the one layer that is still held. Held-out loss stays within 0.003 of every baseline. Speed needs a more careful reading. Standard training without expert-gradient clipping is as fast as Sonar-MoE on OLMoE (115.9 vs. 116.1 ms), so on OLMoE the whole speedup over standard training comes from not clipping the expert gradients. On Granite Sonar-MoE is a further 11.6% faster than that baseline, which § 5.3 traces to idle GPU time. All-parameter optimizer-in-backward matches Sonar-MoE in both memory and speed and differs only in giving up global-norm clipping on the dense parameters. ScatterMoE shows the same pattern. Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 21.1% on OLMoE and 19.1% on Granite, is as fast as standard training without expert-gradient clipping on OLMoE (133.2 vs. 133.3 ms), and is 5.9% faster than that baseline on Granite (88.2 vs. 93.7 ms), a smaller gain than with SonicMoE.

Fine-tuning raises ARC-Challenge accuracy by 3–5 points and leaves HellaSwag and MMLU almost unchanged. The two training methods differ by 0.016 on ARC-Challenge, about one standard error, and by at most 0.001 on HellaSwag and MMLU. We evaluate only OLMoE and omit GSM8K, where this model stays near 0.1 accuracy after Alpaca fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 光是损失并不能显示微调模型是否仍然有用,因此我们也评价OLMOE检查站在下游任务上走出2000步后(表2). 微调将ARC-Challenge精度提升了3–5分,使HelaSwag和MMLU几乎保持不变. 两种训练方法在ARC-Challenge上各有0.016个,大约是一个标准出错;在HelaSwag和MMLU上最多0.001个。 我们只评价OLMoE并省略了GSM8K,这个模型在阿尔帕卡微调后会保持接近0.1的精度.

blocks.en: 5.3 Sources of the Speedup
blocks.zh: 5.3 加速的来源

Profiling adds CPU overhead, so absolute times are higher than in Table 1 ; compare bars only. “Clip” covers the norm and scaling kernels of global-norm clipping, which take 1.8–1.9 ms on OLMoE and 1.1–1.2 ms on Granite when the expert gradients are not clipped. “Fwd+bwd” covers the forward and backward kernels.
blocks.zh: 图3 步入时间(每步 ms):300-309步的火炬.profile.profile. 剖析会增加CPU的间接费用,因此绝对时间高于表1;只比较条. " 剪接 " 涵盖全球标准剪接的规范和内核,当专家梯度不剪接时,OLMOE的剪接需要1.8至1.9毫秒,而Granite的剪接需要1.1至1.2毫秒。 “Fwd+bwd”涵盖前向和后向内核。

blocks.zh: 表3:虎克颗粒性。 两种布局都持有同一种内存;每个专家的钩子每步可调用2个EL 2EL优化器,而不是2个L 2L.

blocks.en: Three effects explain the step times (Figure 3 ). First, global-norm clipping of the expert gradients costs about 25 ms of kernel time per step on OLMoE (26.9 vs. 1.8 ms). It reads the 12.9 GB of gradients to compute the norm, then reads and writes them again to rescale them. This accounts for nearly all of the difference between standard training and Sonar-MoE on OLMoE. The cost scales with the number of expert parameters rather than with the batch, which is why it matters most for small batches (§ 5.5 ). Second, on Granite the GPU work is the same with and without in-backward updates (57.7 vs. 57.4 ms busy), but idle time falls from 65 to 42 ms. Granite’s backward pass is limited by kernel-launch overhead, and the in-backward AdamW kernels run in these gaps. OLMoE leaves little idle time, so it gains almost nothing from this. Third, attaching hooks per expert keeps the memory saving but adds 23.6 ms per step on OLMoE, about 12 μ \mu s per extra optimizer call (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 三能解释步入时间(图3. 首先,在OLMOE(26.9对1.8ms)上对专家梯度进行全球规范剪接,每步花费约25毫秒内核时间. 它读取了12.9GB的梯度来计算规范,然后读取并再写出它们来重新标出. 这几乎说明了标准训练与OLMOE上的Sonar-MoE之间的所有区别. 成本尺度以专家参数数量而不是批量计算,因此,对于小批量而言,成本尺度最为重要(第5.5节)。 其次,在Granite上,GPU的工作是相同的,无论是否有后退更新(57.7对57.4ms繁忙),但闲暇时间从65至42ms. 格拉尼特的后传受到内核发射高空的限制,后发的亚当W内核在这些缺口中运行. OLMOE留下了很少的闲暇时间,因此从中几乎没有收获. 第三,每个专家的接通钩能保存内存,但在OLMOE上每步增加23.6 ms,每多拨12 μ\mu s(表3).

blocks.en: 5.4 Exactness and Training Quality
blocks.zh: 5.4 准确性和培训质量

blocks.en: Without gradient accumulation, Sonar-MoE performs the same arithmetic as standard training that clips only the non-expert gradients. We train OLMoE for three steps with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , large enough that bf16 updates are visible, and compare the weights of two runs element by element (Table 4 ). Sonar-MoE and standard training without expert-gradient clipping give exactly the same 6.44B expert weights. They differ in 6 of the 477M other weights, and two runs of the same baseline also differ in 6 elements, so this is ordinary run-to-run noise, not an effect of the schedule. Per-expert and batched hooks also give the same expert weights, and all-parameter optimizer-in-backward gives exactly the same weights as standard training without clipping.
blocks.zh: 没有梯度累积,声纳-MOE进行与标准训练相同的算术,只剪接非专家梯度. 我们为OLMOE训练了三个步骤,学习率为10−4 10^{-4},大到可以看见bf16更新,并按元素比较两个运行元素的权重(表4). 声纳-MOE与标准训练没有专家分级剪接,给予完全相同的6.44B专家权重. 它们在477M其他重量中的6个有差异,同一个基准的两个运行在6个元素中也有差异,因此这是普通的运行到运行的噪音,而不是时刻表的效果. 每名专家和分批的钩子也给予同样的专家权重,全参数优化后置器给予与标准训练完全相同的权重而无剪接.

blocks.en: Table 4: Weights that differ between two runs after three steps on OLMoE (6.44B expert weights, 477M other weights).
blocks.zh: 表4:在OLMOE(6.44B专家权重,477M其他权重)上三步后,两步相差的重量.

blocks.en: Clipping the expert gradients, as standard training does, changes 47% of the expert weights after three steps, yet changes held-out loss on OLMoE by only 0.0014 after 2,000 steps (Table 1 ). AdamW divides each update by a running estimate of the gradient scale, which largely cancels a uniform rescaling.
blocks.zh: 如标准训练一样,计算专家梯度会改变3个步骤之后专家权重的47%,然而,在2000个步骤之后,OLMOE只改变了0.0014。 AdamW将每次更新除以一个运行中的梯度尺度估计,这在很大程度上取消了一个统一的缩放.

blocks.en: Because weights are stored in bf16, an update smaller than half a unit in the last place of a weight is rounded away. Table 5 shows that after 2,000 steps most weights still hold their pretrained values, and that the two methods change the same share of weights.
blocks.zh: 因为重量被存储在bf16中,一个重量倒数最后一个位置上小于半个单位的更新被四舍五入. 表5显示,在2000个步骤之后,大多数重量仍然维持其预先受试的数值,两种方法改变相同的重量份额.

blocks.en: Table 5: Share of weights that differ from their pretrained values after 2,000 steps of bf16 training on OLMoE.
blocks.zh: 表5:在对OLMOE进行2 000个步骤的bf16培训后,其重量份额不同于其预受训练值。

blocks.zh: 5.5 批量大小和内存组成

blocks.en: The cost of clipping expert gradients is fixed per step (22–29 ms), so the speedup over standard training shrinks from 18% at batch size 2 to 8% at batch size 32 (Figure 4 ). With the same update rule, Sonar-MoE and standard training are within ± \pm 1.1% at batch sizes 2–16, and at batch size 32 Sonar-MoE is 4.0% faster. The memory saving also shrinks with batch size, because activations, not gradients, set the peak at large batches. The saving in peak allocated memory is 12.0 GB at batch size 2, 9.4 GB at 8, 5.2 GB at 16 and none at 32, where only 2.2 GB of reserved memory is saved. Sonar-MoE helps most when batches are small relative to the model. In practice the saving can be read off Eq. 2 : it equals the expert-gradient buffer as long as gradients, not activations, set the peak.
blocks.zh: 剪接专家梯度的成本固定在每步(22–29 ms)上,因此标准训练速度从分批大小2的18%缩减到分批大小32的8%(图4). 以相同的更新规则,声纳-MOE和标准训练在分批量大小2–16的±\pm 1.1%范围内,分批量大小32的声纳-MOE更快4.0%. 内存保存也随着批量大小而收缩,因为活化不是梯度,将峰值设定为大批量. 峰值分配内存的保存为12.0 GB,分批大小为2,9.4 GB为8,5.2 GB为16,没有为32,其中只保存了2.2 GB的保留内存. 相较于模型的批量小时,声纳-MOE帮助最多. 在实践中,保存可以被从 Eq. 2 读取: 只要梯度,而不是活化,设置峰值,它就等于专家级缓冲.

blocks.en: Gradient checkpointing does not lower peak memory at batch size 2, because activations are small, and only costs time (+10–16%, Table 6 ). 8-bit AdamW and Sonar-MoE save different memory, optimizer states and gradients, so they combine. Together they need about 30 GB and run under a 30.5 GB cap, where 8-bit AdamW alone runs out of memory. All-parameter optimizer-in-backward gives the same savings. It also runs under the 46 GB cap, and with 8-bit AdamW its peak allocated memory matches ours (29.7 vs. 29.9 GB). 8-bit AdamW is slower per step (186 vs. 141 ms).
blocks.zh: 渐入检出不会降低第2批大小的峰值内存,因为活化度很小,而且只花费时间(+10–16%,表6). 8-bit AdamW和Sonar-MoE保存不同的内存,优化状态和梯度,所以它们结合. 他们一起需要约30GB并运行在30.5GB的封顶下,在那里仅8位亚当W就耗尽了内存. 所有参数的优化后退都带来同样的节省。 它也运行在46GB的封顶下,并用8位亚当W的峰值分配的内存与我们的相匹配(29.7对29.9GB). 8位亚当W每步较慢(186对141ms).

blocks.en: For the combination that fits OLMoE fine-tuning on a 32 GB GPU, we also check that quality is preserved. We use the setup of Table 1 (2,000 steps, batch size 2, seed 42) but store the AdamW states in 8 bits with bitsandbytes AdamW8bit ( Dettmers et al., 2022 ) . With Sonar-MoE , each expert tensor gets its own 8-bit optimizer inside its hook, and the other parameters use one 8-bit optimizer at the end of the step with global-norm clipping, as in Table 1 . Held-out loss stays within 0.003 of standard training (Table 7 ), so the memory saving of 8-bit AdamW and Sonar-MoE comes at no visible cost in quality.
blocks.zh: 对于符合OLMoE在32GB GPU上微调的组合,我们也检查质量是否保存. 我们使用表1的设置(2,000步,批量大小2,种子42),但将亚当W的状态以8比特和比特字节亚当W8比特(Dettmers等,2022年)存储. 与 Sonar-MoE 相通,每个专家的收音机在钩子内部获得自有的8位优化器,而其他参数则使用一个8位优化器在步骤后端使用全局规范剪接,如表1所示. Hold-out lost stays under 0.003 into standard training (表7)),因此8位亚当W和声纳-MOE的内存节省在质量上没有明显成本.

blocks.zh: 5.6 逐渐积累

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The most direct benefit is that a run fits where it did not before. Fine-tuning OLMoE-1B-7B in our setup peaks at 55.6 GB with standard training and at 43.6 GB with Sonar-MoE , which fits on a 48 GB GPU, since it runs under a 46 GB allocator cap where standard training runs out of memory. With 8-bit AdamW it fits a 32 GB GPU (30.5 GB cap), where 8-bit AdamW alone does not. All-parameter optimizer-in-backward reaches the same peak memory and also fits under the 46 GB cap. Gradient checkpointing does not reduce peak memory at batch size 2 (§ 5.5 ), and the saving shrinks as batches grow, because activations then set the peak.
blocks.zh: 最直接的好处是,跑步与以前不同。 精细调整 OLMOE-1B-7B 在我们的设置峰值为55.6 GB并有标准训练,43.6 GB并有声纳-MoE,这符合48 GB GPU,因为它运行在46 GB分配器封顶下,标准训练耗尽了内存. 有8位的亚当W,它符合32GB GPU (30.5 GB cap),其中8位的亚当W单曲不配. 全参数优化后置达到同一峰值内存,也符合46GB盖下. 渐入检查不会减少分批量大小2 (§ 5.5)的峰值内存,而储蓄会随着分批量的增加而收缩,因为激活后会设置峰值.

blocks.en: Our results point to a simple rule. Early release is a good default when four conditions hold: the optimizer is element-wise, gradients are not accumulated across microbatches, the experts are stored in batched tensors, and the expert gradients are not needed for global-norm clipping. The memory saving is largest at small batch sizes. A speed benefit appears only when the baseline clips expert gradients or when the backward pass leaves the GPU idle. With accumulation the method becomes a different and slower optimizer (§ 5.6 ), and with per-expert hooks it keeps the memory saving but loses time (§ 5.3 ). We think this kind of explicit operating range is more useful to practitioners than a single headline number, and we have tried to report every regime we measured, including the ones where the method does not help.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示一个简单的规则。 提前放出是一种很好的默认,因为有四个条件存在:优化器是元素取向的,跨微管的梯度不累积,专家被储存在分批的分数计数器中,全球规范剪接不需要专家梯度. 保存内存量最大的是小批量大小. 速度好处仅在基线剪辑专家梯度或后传让GPU闲置时出现. 随着积分的积累,该方法成为了不同且更慢的优化器(§ 5.6),而每位专家的钩子则保留了内存但会失去时间(§ 5.3). 我们认为,这种明确的操作范围对从业人员比一个标题号码更有用,我们曾试图报告我们衡量的每一个制度,包括方法无益的制度。

blocks.en: Optimizer-in-backward methods were developed for dense models, where each weight matrix is one parameter and the question of hook granularity never arises. In MoE code it does arise. Expert weights are often stored as a list of per-expert modules for readability, or are split into per-expert views when a checkpoint is loaded. Both cases silently multiply the hook count by E E . Our ablation shows that this keeps the memory saving intact but adds 20% (OLMoE) and 72% (Granite) step time (Table 3 ), so the problem is easy to overlook if only memory is measured.
blocks.zh: 为密集模型开发出优化后置方法,每个重量矩阵都是一个参数,钩子颗粒性问题从未出现. 在教育部的代码中,它确实出现了。 专家权重通常作为每个专家模块的可读性清单被存储,或者在加载检查站时被拆分为每个专家视图. 这两种情况都沉默地将钩数乘以E E. 我们的衰竭表明,这保持了内存保存完好,但增加了20%(OLMOE)和72%(Granite)的步入时间(表3),因此如果只测量了内存,这个问题很容易被忽略.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In MoE training, the gradients of all experts usually sit in memory until the optimizer step, even though each one is needed only for its own update. Sonar-MoE updates every batched expert tensor as soon as its gradient is ready and frees the gradient right away, which bounds the retained expert-gradient memory by one layer. At batch size 2 it lowers peak memory by 21.6% on OLMoE and 21.4% on Granite, and its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert-gradient clipping. Its speed advantage over standard training comes from not clipping the expert gradients and, on models whose backward pass leaves the GPU idle, from running the optimizer kernels in that idle time. Hooks attached per expert save the same memory but make each step 20–72% slower, so early release should be attached to batched expert tensors. All-parameter optimizer-in-backward matches the method in memory and speed. Natural next steps are to support global-norm clipping without keeping all gradients in memory, and to support data parallelism by updating after the gradient all-reduce. We are also extending Sonar-MoE to inference, where expert computation can be started speculatively before the router’s decision is final and reconciled against the exact routing, so that the same early-release principle speeds up both training and inference of MoE models.
blocks.zh: 在教育部的训练中,所有专家的梯度通常都放在记忆中,直到最优化的步骤为止,尽管每个梯度只需要自己的更新. 声纳-MOE一旦其梯度准备好即更新了每个分批的专家收录器,并立即释放出梯度,这就将保留下来的专家级内存以一层相接. 在分批量2时,在OLMOE上将峰值内存降低21.6%,在Granite上降低21.4%,其更新与标准训练的比特式相同而无专家级剪接. 它相对于标准训练的速度优势来自于不剪接专家梯度,而对于后传让GPU闲置的模型,则来自于在那个闲置时间里运行最优化的内核. 每个专家所附加的钩子可以保存同样的内存,但使每个步骤慢了20-72%,因此提前释放应该附加在分批专家的计分器上. 全参数优化后置与内存和速度方法相匹配. 接下来的自然步骤是支持全局-规范剪接,而不将所有梯度保留在内存中,并通过梯度全减后更新支持数据并行化. 我们还在将Sonar-MoE推论扩大为推论,在路由器的决定是最终决定之前,可以推测地开始专家计算,并与准确的路由进行调和,这样同样的早期放行原则就可以加快培训和推论部的模型.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Gradient clipping. Standard global-norm clipping needs all gradients before any update, while Sonar-MoE updates experts during backward. Compatibility can be restored by delaying the update and keeping, offloading or recomputing the gradients after the norm is known, or by clipping each expert tensor by its own norm inside the hook. We plan to evaluate these options in the next version. Gradient accumulation. With A ≥ 2 A{\geq}2 the method applies A A updates per step and becomes a different optimizer that is 5–35% slower than standard training with global clipping (§ 5.6 ), so our main results use A = 1 A{=}1 . The schedule is exact for element-wise optimizers such as AdamW, SGD or Lion, and extending it to optimizers that need statistics across tensors is left to future work. Scope of the evidence. All results use one GPU, and under data parallelism the update would run after the gradient all-reduce, which we will add by integrating with the communication hooks. The memory saving is largest at small batch sizes and shrinks as activations dominate. We train in bf16 and test models up to 7B parameters on Alpaca fine-tuning with one seed, using same-seed repeats to measure noise; larger models, more datasets and more seeds are planned for the next experiments.
